reference_opening.argument: This video is non-scam content because it is an instructional promotion for recruiting and placing new members within Mirror Trading International's left or right team leg. It directs viewers to use referral and registration links, but it does not show a deceptive promise, required payment, claimed financial return, or request for sensitive data. The content explains how the placement system works rather than presenting a concrete fraudulent solicitation.

citations.quote: When you send someone your registration link, the system will place the person in your weaker leg.
You can copy this and send it to your prospects.
Auto, left or right.
As your team grows you may want to give out a specific placement link.

opening.argument: The requested action is not merely to view information: viewers are instructed to copy a registration link and send it to prospects, after which those people become members in the sender's business structure. The system then assigns each recruit to a weaker leg or lets the sender choose left or right placement. That directly links recruiting new participants to expansion and management of a team-based structure, which is characteristic of a recruitment-driven enrollment mechanism rather than an ordinary informational referral.

citations.quote: You can copy this and send it to your prospects.
Once they have registered, they will be placed in your weakest leg, unless you have instructed them to choose a specific leg.
As your team grows you may want to give out a specific placement link.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense calls this an operational tutorial, but that description understates what the tutorial operationalizes: recruiting prospects through personalized registration links and positioning them inside a two-leg business. Calling the links instructional does not explain why the viewer is told to send them to prospects or why placement within the growing team matters. The absence of an explicit return figure does not eliminate the recruitment-structure signal.

citations.quote: You can copy this and send it to your prospects.
As your team grows you may want to give out a specific placement link.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The instructions establish recruitment and placement, but they do not establish that income depends on downlines, commissions, qualification, or tier status. “Business” and “team” describe the organizational arrangement; they do not show a payment obligation or an earnings promise. The links therefore support an instructional referral workflow, not the required recruitment-income claim.

citations.quote: As your team grows you may want to give out a specific placement link.
For more information please contact your team leader

opening.argument: Several risk signals appear together: the video promotes external referral links, directs the viewer to recruit “prospects,” assigns recruits to a weaker leg, and offers separate links for auto, left, and right placement. The visual presentation also depicts new team members branching into a left-right structure. Taken together, this is not a neutral link-management feature; it is a streamlined mechanism for adding people to a sponsor-linked matrix and optimizing where they sit within it. That coordinated recruitment architecture is the central concern.

citations.quote: Using the various Referral Links in Mirror Trading International
When you send someone your registration link, the system will place the person in your weaker leg.
Look at these links a bit closer and you will discover three different options. Auto, left or right.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense lists what the tutorial lacks, but a recruitment scam signal can arise from the mechanism being promoted, not only from a stated profit percentage. Here the links are not generic contact tools: they determine sponsor-related placement in a left-right team, and the video advises strategic planning as the team grows. Those details are more significant than the absence of a plainly stated return.

citations.quote: It may be a good idea to speak to the person who sponsored you and plan a little more strategically.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: These are organizational choices, not evidence of deceptive earnings. Referral links, automatic placement, and left-right placement show how registration is routed, while the branching image does not show money, commissions, paid tiers, or promised outcomes. The cited signals may justify scrutiny, but they do not prove that participation generates recruitment income.

citations.quote: Auto, left or right.
the system will automatically place the person in the weakest leg of your business

opening.argument: Although presented as a tutorial, the video functions as promotional onboarding for participation in Mirror Trading International. It identifies the back-office referral feature, explains how to distribute registration links, tells the viewer to share them with prospects, and closes by directing viewers to a team leader. The repeated focus on growing a team and strategically placing members makes the lesson operationally persuasive: it equips an existing participant to recruit others into a sponsor-linked left-right structure.

citations.quote: You can find your registration link in your back office.
You can copy this and send it to your prospects.
As your team grows you may want to give out a specific placement link.
For more information please contact your team leader

rebuttal.rebuttal: Describing the content as education does not neutralize its promotional function. The lesson is valuable precisely because it teaches participants how to recruit and position additional members, including how to plan strategically with the sponsor. Its practical instructions move viewers toward expanding the team, so the educational format is the delivery method for the promotion.

citations.quote: It may be a good idea to speak to the person who sponsored you and plan a little more strategically.
How can I make sure my new members go into either the left or right leg of my business?

true_side_reply.rebuttal: A tutorial can explain how an existing platform works without promising earnings or concealing a payment arrangement. The evidence shows instructions for selecting registration placement and contacting a team leader, but it does not show that recruiting members produces commissions or that users must buy anything. Promotion of participation alone is insufficient for the specified recruitment-income category.

citations.quote: All that is left is to decide which link you would be sharing first.
For more information please contact your team leader
